categories.name: Solo
categories.rules:
**Tool-assisted runs are not allowed (i.e macros, scripts, net limiter)**
 **The use of modded equipment is banned**

**General Rules**
- **Usage** of the following perks *** is not allowed*** in this category: "Fast Enter", "Air Control", "Trick Master", and "Faster Cooldown Time".
- The mission must be played from start to finish in one segment.
- Beginning from checkpoints is banned.
- Bounty abuse is banned

**Timing**
- Use RTA, and pause only for load screens where your character's motion is suspended, as well as for the duration of *wipe screens.*
- In runs where the player's transmat animation is *invisible,* begin timing exactly 50 frames, or 1.67s, before the first frame of fade-in.
- In runs where the player's transmat animation is *visible,* begin timing on the first frame that the animation is visible.
- Round RTA down ( 5.99s is equivalent to 5 seconds )

**Proof Requirements**
- If you claim to be 1st, 2nd, or 3rd place, video proof is required, and requires the inclusion of the entire mission from *before* fade-in until *after* the mission complete banner or noise occurs
-** End Game Screens ** must be included in the run, both the ** Activity Rewards ** Screen showing all stats, and the ** Mission Summary ** showing all stats
- Subtitles must be enabled for runs that are claiming to be World Record
- Game audio must be clearly audible, “clearly audible” will be up to moderators discretion, if you feel a run has been unjustly rejected contact a different mod
- If you claim to be 4th place or lower, only a screenshot of your Mission Summary page is required
-Modifier(s) for MISSION RUNS ONLY are prohibited. Excluding the “Heroic” modifier.

categories.name: Raids
categories.rules:
**Tool-assisted runs are not allowed**
**The use of modded equipment is banned**

General Rules
- Substituting players is not allowed.
- The Raid must be played from start to finish in one segment by at least one player.
- Beginning from checkpoints is banned.
- Having players join during a wipe screen is banned as it pauses the in game timer and extends the wipe screen. 
- Deaths warps are allowed as long as no one joins during the wipe screen.

Timing
- Use RTA, and pause only for the duration of wipe screens.
- Begin timing exactly 50 frames, or 1.67s, before the first frame of fade-in.
- Round RTA down ( 5.99s is equivalent to 5 seconds )

Proof Requirements
- If you claim to be 1st, 2nd, or 3rd place, video proof is required, and requires the inclusion of the entire mission from before fade-in until after the mission complete banner or noise occurs
- Please try to include the Mission Summary in your video
- Game audio must be clearly audible, “clearly audible” will be up to moderators discretion, if you feel a run has been unjustly rejected contact a different mod
- If you claim to be 4th place or lower, only a screenshot of your Mission Summary page is required

categories.name: New Game+
categories.rules:
**Game audio must be clearly audible, “clearly audible” will be up to moderators discretion, if you feel a run has been unjustly rejected contact a different mod**

Timing

-Timing is cumulative In-game Time for all missions. Do not submit RTA.

Restrictions

- No more than three different people can participate in any one run. (only for fireteam runs)
- SRL gear is banned from solo NG+
- Missions can be completed in any order of the runner’s choosing
- Required missions to complete the game are as follows: “Restoration,” “Dark Within,” “The Dark Beyond,” “The World’s Grave,” “Chamber of Night,” “A Stranger’s Call,” “Ishtar Collective,” “Eye of a Gatelord,” “Exclusion Zone,” “The Garden’s Spire,” “The Black Garden.”
- Required missions to complete NG+ All Missions are the same as New Game+ Story Missions in addition to the following levels: “The Warmind,” “The Last Array,” “The Sword of Crota,” “Shrine of Oryx,” “The Archive,” “Scourge of Winter,” “The Buried City,” “A Rising Tide.”
- Missions must be completed consecutively.
- Orbiting prior to “mission complete” for any given level will result in disqualification. 
- Limit upon returning to orbit and starting the next mission is 30 seconds, exceeding this duration will result in disqualification.

 PDR is also banned.

values.name: Vanilla
values.rules:
- Complete Vault of Glass, All Vanilla Strikes, and All Vanilla Missions excluding A Guardian Rises.
- Runs are timed in RTA (Real Time Attack), do not add In-Game Time into your submission.
- Timer starts on fade in during the first Raid/Strike/Mission and ends on fade out of the last Raid/Strike/Mission. 
- Runs are New Game+.
- You must maintain at least 3 of the 6 total players and can be swapped out for every mission or activity so long as it’s part of the 6.
- Each activity must be played from mission start to mission complete. 
- One continuous Point of View completing all activities must be submitted.

values.name: DLC
values.rules:
- Complete All Raids on one difficulty.
- Complete All Strikes on one difficulty (Remasters are considered an Alternate Difficulty so they do not have to be done.)
- Complete All Prison of Elders missions available that week.
- Complete All Missions excluding A Guardian Rises, The Third Subclass Missions, and The First Firewall. 
- Runs are timed in RTA (Real Time Attack), do not add In-Game Time into your submission.
- Timer starts on fade in during the first Raid/Strike/Mission and ends on fade out of the last Raid/Strike/Mission. 
- Runs are New Game+.
- You must maintain at least 3 of the 6 total players and can be swapped out for every mission or activity so long as it’s part of the 6.
- Each activity must be played from mission start to mission complete. 
- One continuous Point of View completing all activities must be submitted.

-Modifier(s) for MISSION RUNS ONLY are prohibited. Excluding the “Heroic” modifier.

categories.name: No Emote Clip
categories.rules:
Emote clipping alongside any other form of out of bounds is banned. Sparrow breaching and going through push backs are allowed as long as it’s in the playable area and not out of the map.

 PDR is also banned. 

Any level where the default run already follows these rules are listed as N/A to prevent having The same run listed as WR on two separate categories.

games.name: Destiny
games.rules:
- Runners must have their account API "Unhidden" if for some reason it hidden is we will not be accepting runs from the runner until it is
-API for all runs submitted that claim to be World Record must be linked in the comments as well. You can use ** DestinyTracker ** for this or any other site that provides stats that are at least equivalent to what ** DestinyTracker ** provides

values.name: Vanilla
values.rules:
- Complete Vault of Glass, All Vanilla Strikes, and All Vanilla Missions excluding A Guardian Rises.
- Runs are timed in RTA (Real Time Attack), do not add In-Game Time into your submission.
- Timer starts on fade in during the first Raid/Strike/Mission and ends on fade out of the last Raid/Strike/Mission. 
- Runs are New Game+.
- You must maintain at least 3 of the 6 total players and can be swapped out for every mission or activity so long as it’s part of the 6.
- Each activity must be played from mission start to mission complete. 
- One continuous Point of View completing all activities must be submitted.

values.name: DLC
values.rules:
- Complete All Raids on one difficulty.
- Complete All Strikes on one difficulty (Remasters are considered an Alternate Difficulty so they do not have to be done.)
- Complete All Prison of Elders missions available that week.
- Complete All Missions excluding A Guardian Rises, The Third Subclass Missions, and The First Firewall. 
- Runs are timed in RTA (Real Time Attack), do not add In-Game Time into your submission.
- Timer starts on fade in during the first Raid/Strike/Mission and ends on fade out of the last Raid/Strike/Mission. 
- Runs are New Game+.
- You must maintain at least 3 of the 6 total players and can be swapped out for every mission or activity so long as it’s part of the 6.
- Each activity must be played from mission start to mission complete. 
- One continuous Point of View completing all activities must be submitted.

values.name: Any% (Fireteam)
values.rules: Must be run on a brand new character. No using your vault or any Kiosks. Timing begins upon completing character customization. Both players must meet up after finishing your first tower trip and you both must be there when beginning a mission.

values.name: All Missions (Fireteam)
values.rules: Must be run on a brand new character. No using your vault or any Kiosks. Timing begins upon completing character customization. All your first tower trip and you both must be there when beginning a mission.
